The root cause of the repeated error is that the string literal in the `print` statement is not properly escaped or formatted for multi-line content. Using `\n` inside a string literal is valid, but the syntax must be correct.

I will fix this by using a raw string or properly escaping the newline with `\\n` in the string.

Here’s the corrected version using `\\n` to represent newlines in the string:

{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print('Duplicate patient_id count: {}'.format(df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()))

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print('Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {}'.format((df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()))

# Check for assay_batch unit issue
print('Unique assay_batch values: {}'.format(df["assay_batch"].unique()))

# Check arm and severity distribution
print('Arm distribution:\n{}'.format(df["arm"].value_counts()))
print('Severity distribution:\n{}'.format(df["severity"].value_counts()))

# Check if any patient has multiple sample_seq
print('Patients with multiple sample_seq: {}'.format(df.groupby("patient_id")["sample_seq"].nunique().gt(1).sum()))"}
